{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Read the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Convert 'revenue' from string to numeric, coercing errors to NaN
# This ensures that if any string is not a valid number, it becomes NaN
df['revenue'] = pd.to_numeric(df['revenue'], errors='coerce')

# Check for any remaining non-numeric values after conversion
non_numeric_revenue = df['revenue'].isnull().sum()

# Filter for completed orders only
completed_orders = df[df['status'] == 'completed']

# Compute the mean revenue for completed orders
mean_revenue_completed = completed_orders['revenue'].mean()

# Check if any completed orders have missing revenue
missing_revenue_in_completed = completed_orders['revenue'].isnull().sum()

non_numeric_revenue, mean_revenue_completed, missing_revenue_in_completed"}
